name: Renji Abarai
note: No build guide available on hideoutgacha.com at time of authoring. Tier/role/damage type sourced from the tier list.

skills.description:
Renji slashes the enemy with Zabimaru 5 times, dealing damage equal to 312% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure. Upon hitting enemies inflicted with Zabi Mark, he accumulates double Spiritual Pressure. ~~Frenzied Dance~~ Press and hold basic attack when Spiritual Pressure is above 20% 
 Renji continuously consumes Spiritual Pressure to rapidly whip an enemy with Zabimaru multiple times, dealing DMG up to 465% of ATK. When the button is released early or Spiritual Pressure runs out, Renji will deal extra DMG equal to 81% of ATK once. 
 
 Releasing special attacks will continuously inflict Lacerate Points on enemies, triggering Lacerate once when they reach 100 and dealing DMG equal to 300% of ATK.
skills.name: Roar, Zabimaru!

skills.description:
Renji plants Zabimaru deep into the ground, and the blade emerges to strike the enemy, dealing damage equal to 199.5% of ATK and pulling them toward him. 
 
 This skill inflicts Zabi Mark that lats 10s on hit.
skills.name: Thrust

skills.description: Renji splits Zabimaru into rapidly flying blades that slash through the air with eerie wails, slicing the enemy multiple times and dealing damage equal to 1482% of ATK.
skills.name: Higazekko

skills.description:
After blocking an enemy attack, Renji swings Zabimaru, dealing DMG equal to 871% of ATK and pulling the attacker toward him. 
 100 Lacerate Points are inflicted when counterattacks hit.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Renji gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
